result.summary: Found 3 issues: a loading spinner obscuring restaurant imagery, a horizontally cut-off card, and a minor icon detail.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, blocking the photo and suggesting the image failed to load or is stuck in a loading state
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads properly, or remove the spinner and show a placeholder image if loading fails

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol' card in 'Fastest near you' is cut off at the right edge of the screen with no visible scroll affordance
issues.suggestion: Add a partial peek of the next card or a scroll indicator to make horizontal scrolling more discoverable

issues.description: The red notification dot on the bell icon slightly overlaps the bell glyph, making it look slightly misaligned
issues.suggestion: Reposition the badge to the top-right corner of the icon with consistent spacing
